questions.question: In God's picture of a watchman, how does the watchman warn the people when he sees a sword coming against their land?

answers.text: He runs from house to house

questions.question: If the prophet Ezekiel fails to warn a wicked man who is going to die, what does God say about Ezekiel?

answers.text: God will hold him accountable for the man's blood
God will choose a new watchman in his place
God will overlook it this one time
